verdicts.quote: An authorized desktop user can find a dedicated Grok entry point through Salesforce app navigation ... without assuming a record page, mobile app, public site, or messaging channel
Prompting the bot for a record by name or ID does not cause the bot to read that record from Salesforce
Prior prompts, prior replies, record context, attachments, images, audio, and tool actions are outside this first text-only scope
A designated regular Salesforce user can ask Grok after a bot-use grant
A user cannot fetch another user's result even with the other user's send identity
On an Apex-backed path, a send whose callout Salesforce refuses due to pending writes, async work, scheduling, or email in the same transaction produces a failure outcome
verdicts.missing: Whether the callout runs synchronously or asynchronously (Queueable/future/batch); the design only reports failure rather than structuring around the restriction

verdicts.quote: Bot logs, error feedback, and operator diagnostics contain no full or partial provider secrets
verdicts.missing: Where the credential is stored (Named/External Credential or protected setting) and that it is never in code or metadata; C-59/C-60 only conditionally mention external credentials

verdicts.quote: exhaustion of the 100-callout allowance per transaction ... 120-second combined callout allowance ... Apex CPU limits are 10,000 ms synchronous ... Heap limits are 6 MB synchronous
While an accepted send is awaiting its result, the user can distinguish pending from a terminal outcome
verdicts.missing: The mechanism by which the view learns the result arrived (platform event, polling, LMS, or inline return)

verdicts.quote: If a result for a terminal send arrives late or arrives twice, it does not replace an existing outcome or create another visible reply
If the bot cannot admit a question to immediate processing, the user receives a refusal or failure
temporary provider error, connection loss, provider timeout ... shows that a new attempt may be made later ... credential or model rejection ... provide operator-directed feedback
If xAI returns HTTP 429 ... the user sees temporary capacity feedback ... A provider error, lost response, timeout, or reconnect produces no automatic second inference
the UI shows that text labeled incomplete as the terminal outcome ... If no terminal outcome has reached an active view within 60 seconds ... the view shows a timeout outcome
Closing or reloading the bot ... shows no retrievable drafts, questions, or replies ... The fields exclude user identifiers, cost, token usage
verdicts.missing: No conversation/turn record shape is defined; only a diagnostic entry without role, text or usage counts

verdicts.quote: Keep zero durable bot transcripts in Salesforce
The bot adds no Salesforce user ID, org ID, session token, record data, or diagnostic reference. Values the user types into the question remain part of the submitted text
For a follow-up, the provider receives only the current question as conversational content
A fresh view has no turn ... nonblank draft from 1 through 4,000 Unicode code points inclusive passes ... visible answer budget of at most 1,024 tokens
inspect service state and current model, check credential presence, replace the credential, select the model, enable or pause service ... look up recent request diagnostics
xAI's documented default audit retention is 30 days for API requests and responses ... The fields exclude user identifiers
verdicts.missing: No in-org audit of who asked what and what was answered; only provider-side retention is described

verdicts.quote: Developer Edition org, scratch org, or development sandbox ... standard gate is 75% overall Apex coverage ... A cloned or refreshed org cannot use the source org's bot connection until independently provisioned
If no terminal outcome has reached an active view within 60 seconds of entering pending, the view shows a timeout outcome
A fresh view has no turn ... the user can distinguish pending from a terminal outcome ... the user sees an unsuccessful outcome
verdicts.missing: Nothing on deliberate visual design beyond listing states

verdicts.quote: Existing flows, triggers, and scheduled jobs continue under the same conditions with the bot enabled or disabled
